records.question: Of the 24 students in class, one-third are in the after-school chess program, and half of those students will be absent from school on Friday for the regional chess tournament. How many of the students in this class are going to that tournament?
records.response:
One-third of the 24 students is 24/3 = 8 students in the after-school chess program.
Half of those students will be absent, so 8/2 = 4 students are going to the tournament.

records.question: Jenny is trying to convince her cat to walk on a leash. The cat spends twenty minutes resisting. Then Jenny coaxes the cat to walk 64 feet at a rate of 8 feet/minute. How many minutes does this whole process take?
records.response:
Jenny coaxes the cat to walk 64 feet / 8 feet / minute = 8 minutes.
The cat spends 20 minutes resisting + 8 minutes + 8 minutes = 36 minutes.
